items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I'll never forget Cecil Payne and I... So we went all down in the water-front, just him and me... I had a good time.

ctx.x: Well, Howard Johnson was playing lead; Cecil Payne was playing baritone, umm, Gale was playing the other tenor and, let's see, (John) the alto player, Brown. Brown was playing the other alto. But Howard Johnson, he went to Europe with Teddy Hill with Dizzy in 1939 and he taught me how to play chess. He's quite a fellow, quite a fellow. That was a good rhythm section.
So did you stay there in Detroit for a while?
